Container.Name: podly-pure-podcasts
Container.Overview:
Podly removes ads from podcasts. For each new episode of a feed you add, it transcribes the audio with Whisper, has an LLM find the ad segments, cuts them out, and serves an ad-free RSS feed you can subscribe to in any podcast app.
After the first start, open the web UI and choose your LLM and transcription providers on the Config page. A Groq API key is enough for both. The default image can also transcribe locally on the CPU; the lite tag leaves local Whisper out.
With REQUIRE_AUTH=true (the default here), the admin account is created on first start from PODLY_ADMIN_USERNAME and PODLY_ADMIN_PASSWORD. Podcast apps then subscribe with the link from each feed's "Subscribe to Podly RSS" button, which carries its own token.
NVIDIA GPU: change the tag to gpu-nvidia-amd64 and add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters (needs the Nvidia Driver plugin).
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: podcast ads adblock sponsor whisper llm rss
Container.Requires: An API key for an LLM provider (Groq, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint). Transcription can use the same Groq key, a remote Whisper API, or local Whisper on the CPU (default image only).

Branch.TagDescription: Smaller image without local Whisper. Transcribe with Groq or a remote Whisper API.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, settings, custom prompts, logs and processed audio.

Config.Name: REQUIRE_AUTH
Config.Description: Require a login for the web UI. Podcast apps then use the tokenised link from each feed's Subscribe to Podly RSS button.

Config.Name: PODLY_ADMIN_USERNAME
Config.Description: Admin account created on first start when REQUIRE_AUTH is true.

Config.Name: PODLY_ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for that admin. Required when REQUIRE_AUTH is true: the container will not start without it. It is only used to create the admin on an empty database; change it later in the web UI.

Config.Name: PODLY_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Session signing key. Set a long random string (for example from: openssl rand -hex 32). Left empty, a new key is generated at every start and everyone is logged out.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as.

Config.Name: PODLY_TRUSTED_PROXY
Config.Description: Behind an HTTPS reverse proxy: the proxy's exact IPv4 address as Podly sees it, so feed links use https. Leave empty otherwise. Never use a Docker bridge gateway address that clients of a published port also appear as.
